ideas.title: The island remade from a picture
ideas.critique: Turning a model's misperception of a photograph into real terrain (cottage as a lumpy hill, friends sliding down it) changes what the ground is, not one more event. It is the round-1 relief idea moved from props to geography, but terrain you can climb is a stronger payoff. The risk is that it reads as an odd bump unless the misreading is clearly recognisable in a still.

ideas.title: Thoughts that fly off
ideas.critique: Turning the agent's real thought bubbles into paper-bird creatures that friends chase and read aloud reaches the human's goal 5 directly, and the words on the wings are real data. Friends chasing a flying object is the moth and the shadow chase again, and the island filling with them is more creatures of a kind it has. The reading-aloud gag is predictable.

ideas.title: Lumi walks like its friends
ideas.critique: This is the same idea the critic already scored in round 1, and a reworded idea is the same idea. A slow rule that changes Lumi's own body language from its real log is distinctive, but different walks are hard to tell apart in a still, and the notice-and-mimic payoff is a small gag. It also risks the goal-6 motion measures.
